ocrText: CHLOE RUM BARREL AGED COCONUT BALTIC MALT BEVERAGE WITH NATURAL FLAVORS 10% ALC/VOL 1 PT 9.36 FL OZ GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may cause health problems.
